notes: Faster everywhere: the chat list opens from the phone instead of waiting for the network, an open chat no longer redraws every message when a read receipt, reaction or typing dot arrives, and the app is about a third lighter to load. A message you send appears at once, with "Send again" if it doesn't go out. Unread chats are impossible to miss: a bright mark with the number of new messages, in every list, also beside a chat you have open. Sounds: soft tones for sent and received messages, voice notes, calls and games — each family can be switched off in Settings, and nothing plays when the app is in the background. Tapping a notification opens that chat, and notifications clear on the phone once you have read the chat anywhere. Camera: selfies keep the framing you saw, with no shutter click in silent mode and better quality; the camera now works in the browser too. On the web: drag files into a chat or paste an image, and screens move with gentle animations. Games: a "?" next to every game explains how to play; Tile Runs and Durak are clearer in a chat. Shared songs show a proper card, and audio files play right in the chat, one after another.
